newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: VA Stahl drops on first-half figures.
newsitem.headline: VA Stahl drops on first-half figures.

text.p: Shares of steel maker VA Stahl shed as much as 3.3 percent in early trading on the Vienna bourse after the group posted a 37 percent drop in first-half net profit and said the second half would be worse still.
Traders said the result was slightly below market expectations, but added the stock should bottom out soon as most of the bad news had already been anticipated by the market.
The shares were down 2.1 percent or seven schillings at 323 at 0815 GMT, up from an earlier low of 319 schillings. The blue-chip ATX was down 0.5 percent at 1,008.33 at the same time.
"We won't see that much of a fall anymore," said one. "The result was a bit worse than expected, but wasn't that much of a surprise." -- Vienna newsroom +431 53112 274
